realms.title: Tihosi ni Mimfumo
realms.subtitle: Ku nga se ta tikharavela, ku sunguleke ku va ni mimfumo, tihosi ni tindhawu ta vuhaxi.

ancient.title: Matimu ya khale
ancient.subtitle: Lavisisa matimu ya khale ya Mozambique.

colonial.title: Matimu ya Vukoloni
colonial.subtitle: Malembe ya 450 ya vulawuri bya Potugali eMozambique.

independent.title: MATIMU YA XIVUMBA
independent.subtitle: Lavisisa matimu ya ntshunxeko ya Mozambique — ku suka hi 1975 ku ya namuntlha.

Hero.title: Matimu, Ndhavuko ni Vukorhokeri
Hero.subtitle: Hinkwaswo Swa Ximozambikani, Eka Ndhawu Yin'we.
Hero.description: Riendzo yi hlanganisa vundzeni, ku kumiwa ka swilo leswintshwa, mahungu ya nkoka, vutleketli ni vutlhari bya ximatsi eka ntokoto wun’we wa xidijitali.
Hero.bottomNote: Pulatifomo ya Xidijitali yo Vona Mozambique

Music.title: Risimu ra Mozambique
Music.subtitle: Mimpfumawulo, Matimu ni Vayimbeleri va Mozambique
Music.description: Kuma mimpfumawulo, vayimbeleri, ma-album ni matimu lama nga vumba ndhavuko wa risimu ra Mozambique.

artists.label: VAYIMBELERI
artists.title: Vayimbeleri va Mozambique
artists.description: Matimu ya vona, mintirho ni mintirho ya vutshila ya vayimbeleri va Mozambique.

discographies.label: MINTIRHO
discographies.title: Ma-album ni Discografia
discographies.description: Kuma ma-album, ti-single ni mintirho ya risimu ya vayimbeleri.

genres.label: MIMPfumawulo
genres.title: Tinxaka ta Risimu ni Mimpfumawulo
genres.description: Marrabenta, Pandza, Timbila, Xigubo, Afro-house ni swin'wana.

history.label: MATIMU
history.title: Matimu ya Risimu
history.description: Kuma ndlela leyi risimu ra Mozambique ri nga kula ha yona eka switukulwana swo hambana.

explore.title: Swiphiqo swa {count} leswi nga fanelangiki ku tshikiwa
explore.subtitle: Ku sukela eka tinhlampfi ta Tofo ku ya eka swihlala swa khale emantshwa, swivangelo swa kahle swo endzela Mozambique — swi hlanganisiwe endhawini yin'we.

history.title: Matimu yo Koma
history.subtitle: Ku suka eka Nkarhi wa Ribye ku ya eka Mozambique ya namuntlha, eka tindzima ta {count} — nkomiso wo hatlisa.

services.title: Vukorhokeri bya Mfumo
services.description: Tidokumente, rihanyo, dyondzo ni mithelo — kuma vukorhokeri bya mfumo, hlaya mahungu ya nkoka u kuma ndlela.
services.emergencyNote: Tinomboro ti nga hundzuka hi ndhawu kumbe hi nkarhi. Tiyisisa eka tindlela ta ximfumo.

entertainment.title: Ntsako
entertainment.description: Kuma leswi u nga swi endla eMozambique, ku sukela eka swiyimbelelo ku ya eka mintlango ni tifilimi.
